summary: Backend GET /api/teacher/overview is fully functional and returns the correct shape/values (5 students, active_window_minutes=30, class_mastery=0.13, assessments=0, needs_attention=0). Authorization is enforced correctly (401 without session, 403 for student). However, the NEW frontend sections (class-overview-section, student-activity-section) are UNREACHABLE from the UI because the TeacherView (data-testid=teacher-radar-view, view=='teacher') has no navigation entry: clicking home-feature-classrooms sets view='classrooms' which renders ClassroomsView ('Manage your classrooms.'), NOT TeacherView. Nothing in featureItems, Home.tsx, or ClassroomsView calls navigate('teacher'). Student login regression passes; student home-launcher renders correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: TeacherView (view='teacher') is orphaned. No button/nav navigates to view='teacher', so data-testid=teacher-radar-view, class-overview-section, overview-* metric cards and student-activity-section never render for a logged-in teacher. Clicking home-feature-classrooms goes to view='classrooms' -> ClassroomsView (management screen), which does not include the new class overview or student activity sections.

integration_issues.flow: Teacher login -> Classroom Radar -> Class overview
integration_issues.issue: New /api/teacher/overview data (overviewQuery) is fetched only when TeacherView mounts, but TeacherView is never reached from any UI element. The React component and data-testids exist in code but are unreachable at runtime.

verification_results.GET /api/teacher/overview (teacher cooki: 200 {students_enrolled:5, active_now:1, active_window_minutes:30, assessments:0, needs_attention:0, class_mastery:0.13, students:[5 entries with student_id,name,active,last_activity_label,last_activity_at,learning_status]}
verification_results.Students list: Demo Student(in_recovery, active=true), Maya Patel/Jon Bell/Priya Shah/Leo Martin (in_recovery, active=false, 'LIFO gap detected')
verification_results.Frontend teacher-radar-view rendered: NO — never reachable; home-feature-classrooms -> view='classrooms' -> ClassroomsView (Manage your classrooms.)

action_items: CRITICAL: Wire up navigation so a teacher can reach view='teacher'. Options: (a) When user.role==='teacher' and view==='classrooms' render <TeacherView/> above/instead of ClassroomsView; (b) Add a featureItem with id='teacher' shown only for teachers; (c) In ClassroomsView (teacher mode), add a 'Open Classroom Radar' button that calls onOpen('teacher'); (d) Redirect navigate() such that teacher clicking 'classrooms' feature sets view='teacher'.

After navigation fix, verify: teacher-radar-view renders with class-overview-section showing 5/1/0/0/13% (active_now legitimately can be 1 due to teacher session activity; API returned 1 during this run), student-activity-section lists all 5 students with badges, and existing radar cards (class-mastery-card etc.) render below unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.tsx line ~194-195: `{view === 'classrooms' ? <ClassroomsView .../> : null} {view === 'teacher' ? <TeacherView .../> : null}` — the 'teacher' branch is dead code because no code path calls setView('teacher').

Home.tsx featureItems (line 21-30) has 'classrooms' -> label 'Classroom Radar' with description that fits BOTH ClassroomsView and TeacherView, but only ClassroomsView is reachable. Consider splitting into a teacher-only 'Classroom Radar' (view='teacher') vs student-only 'Classrooms' (view='classrooms').
Backend routers/learning.py teacher/overview: correct implementation; active_now was 1 when tested (teacher session created within 30 min) — this is expected behavior per the labeled 30-min window.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend /api/teacher/overview verified end-to-end with pytest (4/4 pass). The frontend TeacherView component and all new data-testids exist in /app/frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx (lines ~598-604) but are never rendered because view='teacher' is never triggered by any UI element — 'home-feature-classrooms' maps to view='classrooms' which renders ClassroomsView instead. Main agent must add a navigation path (see action_items). After fix, re-run the UI verification: click Classroom Radar as teacher -> expect [data-testid=teacher-radar-view] with class-overview-section (5/students_enrolled, active_now, 0/assessments, 0/needs_attention, 13% mastery) and student-activity-section listing 5 students.
rca of the issue: TeacherView is guarded by `view === 'teacher'` (Home.tsx line 195) but no button/handler ever calls setView('teacher'). featureItems only lists 'classrooms' (which maps to ClassroomsView). Consequently, the newly-added class-overview-section and student-activity-section cannot be observed by any teacher user through normal UI flow. Fix requires adding a navigation trigger (see action_items).
